post.yt_title: The Bible Never Says Money Is the Root of All Evil 💰 #shorts
post.yt_desc:
The Bible never says "money is the root of all evil." It says: "For the love of money is a root of all kinds of evil" (1 Timothy 6:10 NKJV). Money isn't the problem. Loving it is. The popular saying takes the old King James wording, "For the love of money is the root of all evil," and drops "the love of."

Jesus said, "You cannot serve God and mammon" (Matthew 6:24 NKJV). He wants your heart, not your wallet.

📖 Read it yourself: 1 Timothy 6:6–10 · Matthew 6:19–24 (NKJV)

post.notes:
- 1 Timothy 6:10 NKJV quoted from the start to "evil" (continues ", for which some have strayed from the faith in their greediness, and pierced themselves through with many sorrows."); scroll shows … .
- Matthew 6:24 NKJV: final sentence quoted (verse opens "No one can serve two masters…").
- 'Three words dropped': the KJV reads "For the love of money is the root of all evil"; the saying drops "the love of".
- 'Jesus wants your heart': summary, not in quotes (cf. Matthew 6:21).
